plan.understanding: Create two separate 2.54 mm-thick covers on opposite outer sides of the central hub, each matching its rounded-square outer contour and mating flush to the hub surface.

subtasks.goal: On central body s2, add two distinct solid cover parts matching the complete 50.8 mm × 50.8 mm rounded-square outer contour bounded by X/Z = ±25.4 mm and the r=7.62 mm corner family (faces #47,#49,#51,#54,#56,#59,#61,#62,#66,#68,#70,#73,#75,#78,#80,#81). Seat one cover against outer planar face #53 at Y=27.94 mm and extend it outward to Y=30.48 mm; seat its counterpart against outer planar face #72 at Y=-15.24 mm and extend it outward to Y=-17.78 mm. Each cover must be exactly 2.54 mm thick, remain a separate solid, and use only the outer perimeter—not reproduce the inner boundary loops of faces #53 or #72. Verify and print that both cover profiles span X/Z = -25.4..25.4 mm, their achieved Y ranges are 27.94..30.48 mm and -17.78..-15.24 mm, and correct their placement within the same attempt if those coordinates differ.
